verdict.rationale: Email sync is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack never mentions connecting Gmail or Outlook, two-way email sync, or automatic logging of emails to records. The only email references are email templates and Copilot-generated email drafts, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
